svg.text: DX TimeShift rev A — assembly view (top side, all parts through-hole)
Fits Oberheim DX board 1721A (U701). NOT for DXa (U715). Board 84 x 63 mm, 2 layers. Solder the lowest parts first: resistors, caps, sockets, headers, connectors.
16-way ribbon → DIP-16 IDC plug → DX U701 socket
pin 1 = ▲ mark; silk numbers = DIP pin at the plug
USB end LEFT, parts side up
from the DX - notch = left end
R1, R2, R3 = 1 kΩ (series protection U1 → Nano)
C2-C6 = 100 nF ceramic, C7 = 1 nF ceramic
C4 at U4 pin 14, C5 just below the Nano 5V/GND pins
